hints.content: Since $\displaystyle~\underset{n\to \infty }{\mathop{\lim }}\,{{\left( -1 \right)}^{n}}\ne 0\,$, it is correct to say that the $~n$th term test tells that $~\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty }{{{\left( -1 \right)}^{n}}}~$ diverges.

question.content:
$\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty }{{{\left( -1 \right)}^{n}}}$

**True or false?**

According to the $n^{\text{th}}$ term test, the series diverges.
